project_title: Evaluasi Kinerja Digital Twin Edge–Cloud Multiskala untuk Monitoring Energi dan Okupansi
claim_scope: performance evaluation of a monitoring-oriented one-way Digital Twin prototype using deterministic replay derived from one archived physical-sensor trace; field-origin telemetry and replay benchmark results are reported separately

derived_energy.interpretation: Derived from the recorded legacy V×I power field. It is a reproducible monitoring indicator, not a direct kWh-meter channel or an active-energy measurement with recorded power-factor evidence.

measurement_provenance.origin: archived telemetry from a physical sensor deployment on a monitored electrical installation
measurement_provenance.gateway_id_semantics: The workbook DeviceID identifies the Raspberry Pi aggregation gateway, not a count or unique identifier of every physical sensing node.

hardware_roles.ESP32: field acquisition node for temperature, humidity, RMS voltage, RMS current, and legacy V×I power
hardware_roles.Raspberry Pi: edge aggregation gateway; the legacy pipeline records its gateway ID for combined telemetry and carries the occupancy/camera path separately

firmware_sensor_chain.power_calculation: RMS voltage multiplied by RMS current; no power-factor channel in the archived firmware

pln_kwh_reference_comparison.reference: display reading of the PLN kWh meter for the monitored installation
pln_kwh_reference_comparison.interpretation: The comparison supports the field origin and prior practical verification of the sensor deployment, but this repository cannot recompute a calibration error without timestamped start/end meter readings.

near_realtime_deadline.basis: operational deadline rounded from the original trace median inter-record gap of 3.5251918 seconds; not the legacy firmware nominal publish interval

local_monitoring.definition: Structural/electrical value checks, power-consistency check, routing, and payload construction on the local host.
local_monitoring.validation_scope: Software-level structure and value checks only; not field validation or metrological validation of active power.

edge_path.definition: local monitoring processing plus JSON serialization

configured_end_to_end.deadline_basis: operational deadline rounded from the original trace median inter-record gap of 3.5251918 seconds; not the legacy firmware nominal publish interval
configured_end_to_end.freshness_proxy: Processing plus configured network latency; browser rendering and historical age are excluded.
configured_end_to_end.warning: Network latency is configured, not field-measured.
configured_end_to_end.definition: Overall mixture of edge-routed and delivered cloud-routed messages; route composition affects its percentiles.

throughput.definition: Messages divided by measured wall time for monitoring and serialization loop on this machine.

routing.rule: Cloud for missing/non-finite values, invalid electrical readings, current below the legacy 0.1 A threshold, or legacy power above 42.6 W.
routing.basis: p99 legacy power in the original historical trace plus software rules for missing, non-finite, invalid electrical, and sub-0.1 A readings

data_quality.validity_definition: All required values are finite and electrical values satisfy the software bounds; this is not field validation.

legacy_proxy_energy.interpretation: Trapezoidal integral of the transformed CSV replay payload's legacy V×I field. This is workload context; the archived field-trace energy is calculated separately and no direct kWh-meter or power-factor channel is included.

architecture_comparison.comparison_basis: Same replay sample, local processing, serialized payloads, seed, and configured network draws. This is a controlled emulation comparison, not a measured public-cloud trial.

field_trace_energy.interpretation: Derived from the recorded legacy V×I power field. It is a reproducible monitoring indicator, not a direct kWh-meter channel or an active-energy measurement with recorded power-factor evidence.

replay_payload_energy.interpretation: Derived from the transformed CSV replay payload. It supports the replay API and workload demonstration only; the field-trace energy is calculated separately from the exported XLSX. The cumulative value resets for each replay cycle.

application_lod.detail: macro geospatial context, legacy coordinate, and edge-cloud relation
building-level monitoring summary, energy, occupancy, and routing
detailed indoor 3D scene, sensor state, and occupancy indicator

digital_twin.scale_semantics: three project-defined application LoD levels: LoD-A geospatial site, LoD-B building, and LoD-C indoor 3D; conformance to CityGML, IndoorGML, IFC, or 3D Tiles geometric LoD has not been evaluated

excluded_claims: recomputed calibration error against the PLN kWh meter, because interval readings are not stored in this repository
active-power or power-factor measurement beyond the legacy V×I signal
survey-validated geospatial coordinates or standards-certified LOD
raw equality between the replay CSV and exported workbook
